Clean digital illustration, no text, no watermark, no border. a Jeju island seaside with dol-hareubang stone statues, yellow canola flowers, a turquoise sea and Hallasan mountain far away. Use exactly the same soft pastel crayon-like art style, colours and line quality as the attached background, but draw this completely different place. Landscape 16:9. Scenery only, no characters, no people, no animals, no text. Leave open empty ground in the lower centre for characters to stand.
